# 1 Chronicles 7 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 7 (40 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.21 — "men of Gath who were born in the land" vs. "natives of Gath"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the men of Gath who were born in the land" / **PNEUMA:** "the natives of Gath"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "The men of Gath who were born in the land" — preserves Hebrew emphasis on native status.

---

## V.23 — Beriah naming etymology
- **EMET:** "in-evil she-was in-his-house" / **LOGOS:** "disaster had befallen his house" / **PNEUMA:** "'Born in Misfortune' — tragedy had struck his family"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "because disaster had befallen his house" — no added name-translation.

---

## V.4 — "sons" vs. "children"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "wives and sons" / **PNEUMA:** "wives and children"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "wives and sons" — *banim* means "sons" in this context.

---
*— SOPHIA*
